name: Sequestered Shabti (CR 11)
body:
Sequestered Shabti
CR 11

Type magic; Notice Perception DC 33; Remove Disable Device DC 33

Trigger location (alarm); Duration varies; Reset automatic (1 day)

EFFECTS

Spell effect (polymorph any object; the target is turned into a foot-tall figurine version of itself and teleported to area A11, Fortitude DC 22 negates)
